title: Candy Corn > Beetroots
description: Beetroots are retextured to Candy Corn
body:
Does anybody actually LIKE **beetroots**? Well no matter, this resourcepack is here to replace them with something MUCH more fun: **candycorn**!

![Candy Corn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/971f7ead883c816afbac3b8f14ec9bf7a97f62d9_0.webp)

Plant magic candy seeds and grow your own candy corn! Eat them one by one or put a couple in a bowl! You'll never have to look at beetroot soup again!
